evals.prompt: That worked! The bug was that our SOFA cardiovascular subscore used norepinephrine doses in mcg/min instead of mcg/kg/min because the weight join dropped patients with missing admission weight, so we silently imputed 0. We fixed it in R/sofa.R by carrying forward the most recent weight within 72h and flagging missing ones. Document this so the next analyst doesn't hit it.
evals.expected_output: Asks the Full vs Lightweight mode question and waits; after the choice, writes one bug-track solution doc under the schema-mapped docs/solutions/<category>/ directory with validated frontmatter including a fingerprint, then runs the discoverability check.
expectations: Presents the Full (recommended) vs Lightweight choice and waits for the user's answer without pre-selecting a mode
Writes exactly one solution doc at docs/solutions/<category>/<sanitized-problem-slug>.md with no date suffix in the filename, where category is mapped from problem_type via references/yaml-schema.md
Frontmatter includes the required fields module, date (YYYY-MM-DD), problem_type, component, severity, plus bug-track symptoms, root_cause, resolution_type, and a computed fingerprint field
Runs scripts/validate-frontmatter.py (anchored via SKILL_DIR) or reports MANUAL_CHECK and applies the manual checks, and does not declare success while validation fails

evals.prompt: Lightweight please. We settled on a convention: always report small cells as '<11' and never back-calculate them from row totals in Table 1 — the IRB flagged our last draft. Capture this as team guidance.
evals.expected_output: In lightweight mode, writes a single knowledge-track doc (context, guidance, applicability) in one pass without subagents or overlap detection, and prints the lightweight completion output.
expectations: Launches no subagents and performs no Related Docs Finder overlap check
Classifies the learning on the knowledge track (e.g. reporting_convention) and writes it to the mapped directory (e.g. docs/solutions/reporting-conventions/)
Doc contains Context, Guidance with an example, and an applicability note, and does not force bug-track fields
Prints the 'Documentation complete (lightweight mode)' output listing the created file
Does not ask the session-history follow-up question (that is Full mode only)
